title: Anthropic launches dashboard, animation tools for Claude
key_facts: Anthropic launched two beta features for Claude: Dashboards and Motion.
Dashboards connects data sources such as BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake or Salesforce and turns them into auto-updating live dashboards from a text prompt.
Every number shows its underlying query; results can be piped into tools such as Amplitude, Grafana or Hex, Anthropic says.
Motion creates animated explainer videos from text, diagrams and images; they are editable as code and exportable as MP4.
Dashboards is available to paid users; Motion to Team and Enterprise plans.
Docs, Slides and Design leave beta and work across all plans, including free accounts; Anthropic says more than 45 million documents have been created with these tools.
The earlier announced Claude Design will be folded into the main app by 14 December.
